page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with one small printed mark in the right margin beside "De salute". Below the text: the catchword at the lower right and the gathering signature at the lower left. Running head and page number at the top.

main_text.l: diciis impiorum istius temporis occupatos, huic annun-ciationi
& demonstrationi fidem adhibituros ; atque
adeo praedicit populi istius carnalis incredulitatem &
per-fidiam, tempore Christi & euangelii manifestandam, quae
causa foret, cur à communione populi spiritualis
se separarent. Hanc Judaeorum carnalium perfidiam &
in-fidelitatem, quâ nec euangelium, nec regnum Christi
admitterent, saepius notatam videas in verbo prophe-
1. Mich. 6: 9. Nah. 1: 11. De salute per Chri-
ftum adducendâ non rectè sentientes, & spiritualem
redemptionem ignorantes, nil 'nisi corporalem libera-
tionem & prosperitatem sibi à Christo spondebant, &
umbram pro corpore amplectebantur, quam omittere
negarent: ac proin doctrinam justitiae imputatae & liber-
tatis oppugnantes, ejus professores expellerent: un-dè
pii à communione istorum, veritatem ejusque con-
fessores opprimentium, liberarentur; quae oeconomia piis
erat in votis.
Ast dubium videri possit, quo pacto improbi istius
temporis dicantur euangelio non credituri, cum illi vi-
tam ad istum terminum non prorogarent ? Verum huic
non credituri erant eorum posteri, pravae eorum sen-
tentiae haeredes, in quibus quasi viverent postmodum
parentes: atque ita cum posteris, ejusdem opinionis
hominibus, concipiuntur tanquam unum collectivum,
& ejusdem farinae, in quibus manifestaretur, quid, si ipsi
viverent, ipsi facerent.

page.notes: The asterisk in the right margin beside "De salute per Chri-" is a printed mark with no note text. "credituri" (twice) is printed with a dotted or doubled final i; read as "credituri" and not certain. The "Vers." catchword is read from a faint print at the lower right. Long s was replaced by plain s throughout, including "Psal." and "Jef.".
